name: r7615-ab-emcts
description: The AB-EMCTS experiment's currency (docs/plans/ab-emcts-vs-oep.md, section 4): a copy of the published r7615-time, which keeps every published price, with the three AB-EMCTS arms priced into it on the R7615 in one session, at the published levels. Server settings as in examples/server.json: no warming up, a wait of up to 30 minutes for the machine to fall quiet, and a session called suspect if other work holds more than 4 logical CPUs.
